swissgear - sa1056 laptop backpack - bla.name: SwissGear - SA1056 Laptop Backpack - Black
swissgear - sa1056 laptop backpack - bla.description: Ready to elevate your backpack game to a higher level? Meet the SWISSGEAR SA1056 ScanSmart Laptop Backpack. Feature-packed, and crafted from durable materials that include a partially molded front panel, this backpack packs a punch, and is destined to become the one you'll definitely want to have around. Equipped with a TSA-friendly lay-flat back panel, it boasts dedicated pockets for your tablet, laptop, adapters, and power pack.  Additionally, it features a front quick-access pocket, a fleece-lined crush-resistant sunglasses pocket, and an organizational pocket integrating both a laminated, zippered pocket in the front, and an RFID protected pocket in the back.  In addition, its ample center compartment features a file pocket, and a large zippered mesh pocket for extra cables and adapters, as well as plenty of room for anything you want to take with you.  Wrapping up an outstanding backpack, exterior features shine, with fully padded, ergonomic shoulder straps  with built in suspension, and a fully-adjustable sternum strap, and a generously padded Airflow back panel, as well as a phone charging hub conveniently located on the side of the bag, which also sports an insulated pocket, an accessory pocket, and dual water bottle pockets.  What else can you ask for?
